verdict.rationale: Factory documents batch-oriented mechanisms — droid exec for CI/CD and batch processing, multi-agent Missions, and Software Factory's cross-repo automation coverage/code review 'across your repos' — which support bulk-style automation at scale. However, there's no concrete example of operating over a large, discrete set of items (e.g., N tickets/PRs processed in one bulk run) or independent verification of throughput at scale. Missing for 10: explicit worked example of bulk/batch item processing across many discrete items, and independent/hands-on confirmation of scale.
